heroSubtitle: I turn product ideas into clear motion — explainers, social cuts and UI animation, with the scope and timeline agreed before we start.
aboutText:
I design motion that explains things: **explainer videos** that make one feature obvious, **social cuts** that survive a scroll, and **UI animation** that makes an interface feel responsive.

I work in **After Effects, Photoshop and Premiere Pro**. The process is simple and visible — we agree the goal and the deliverables, you approve a storyboard, and you get the finished files in the formats each platform needs.

Send me the goal and the deadline; I will tell you honestly what is realistic.
aboutSkills: Explainer Videos, Social Cuts, UI Animation, Storyboarding, After Effects

servicesIntro: Three ways I help teams get motion shipped — each one starts with a clear scope, not a pitch.

services.title: Explainer Videos
services.desc: Script shaping, storyboard, then a finished product animation — delivered in the aspect ratios you need (16:9, 1:1, 9:16).

services.title: Social Content
services.desc: Short, legible animations built for Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok: strong first frame, readable captions, correct safe areas.

services.title: UI Animation
services.desc: Transitions, onboarding moments and empty states for apps and websites — delivered in the format your developers prefer.

processIntro: A transparent, collaborative workflow that keeps you in the loop — no surprises, just great motion.

process.title: Brief & Strategy
process.desc: We align on goals, audience, message and deliverables before any pixel moves.

process.title: Storyboard & Style
process.desc: I sketch the flow and define the visual language — colors, typography, motion mood.

process.title: Motion & Design
process.desc: The core craft. Animation, timing, sound design — iterating with you via frame previews.

process.title: Delivery & Support
process.desc: Optimized exports for every platform, plus the source files. Revision rounds are agreed before we start.
